Implemented the C++20 MARC tool in `output/`. It supports ISO 2709 and MARCXML inspection and rendering, canonical JSON responses, UTF-8 validation, and embedded field rules derived from the supplied MARC documentation.

The build succeeded with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` from `output/`. I also checked an ISO 2709 render/inspect round trip and a MARCXML inspection.

Sources: [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt), [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp), [rules_data.inc](/workspace/output/rules_data.inc), and [nr_fields.inc](/workspace/output/nr_fields.inc).
